    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】

source_snapshot.criteria: Value of Total Memory should be shown correctly

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: sshpass -p "$DUT_PASS" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no $DUT_USER@$DUT_IP "free -m 2>&1 | head -2; echo ---; sudo dmidecode -t 17 2>&1 | grep -c 'Memory Device' 2>&1"
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return FULL return `free -m` total + the count of populated memory slots so user confirms the Total Memory shown on the Main page. No RISK.

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES; OS usable memory and a Memory Device header count cannot prove BIOS Main-page total.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY / CHANGED; distinguishes installed, firmware-reported and OS-usable capacity.
historical_reviews.round_02: No additional exact-code technical record found.
historical_reviews.second_review_handoff: No V3/V3.1 record exists for this variant.

original_test_intent: Visually verify that BIOS Main-page Total Memory matches the approved installed DIMM capacity under the platform's unit and reservation convention.
original_method: Confirm the approved DIMM population/capacity, enter BIOS Setup, capture Total Memory and its unit, reconcile it with populated Type 17 device sizes and any firmware reservation rule, then exit safely.
manual_activity: A human must observe the BIOS Main-page Total Memory and unit; OS usable memory and DIMM inventory can only corroborate different quantities.
required_inputs: DIMM part/population map and summed installed capacity
Expected BIOS total and unit convention
safety_requirements: Do not treat `free` total as installed capacity without reconciliation.
Do not call every Type 17 structure populated.
agent_execution_scope: Collect full `free` and unfiltered Type 17 data when later approved and calculate populated-device capacity.
Reconcile supplied UI/inventory values and document reservations.
Report without claiming UI action or verdict.
engineer_actions: Capture the BIOS Main-page value and unit.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Only partial and partly misleading: `free -m` is OS-usable memory, while `grep -c 'Memory Device'` counts structures/headers rather than summing populated capacity.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Preserve the exact command for provenance but additionally retain full Type 17 records and sum non-empty Size fields; keep UI evidence primary.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Exact command and 10/10-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Compare the UI total with approved physical capacity and parsed populated Type 17 sizes, separately reporting OS-usable memory and reservations.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact DIMM population and BIOS build.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds quantity semantics and correct capacity computation.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: OS total may legitimately be lower than BIOS/installed total.

project_override_considerations: The project supplies target population and accepted reporting convention; a smaller project configuration is valid only for that plan and must not claim other capacities were tested.
expected_evidence: Timestamped BIOS Total Memory with unit
Full populated Type 17 sizes and calculated total
Safe exit/normal boot and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The primary source consistently targets Total Memory. Missing capacity/convention is readiness; DeepSeek's quantity conflation is a review defect.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The UI objective is clear; project memory configuration and console access make it executable.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Reclassifies command-only YES and corrects slot-count/usable-memory limitations.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agrees on manual UI core and installed-versus-usable distinction.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Clarifies project override and engineer-verdict separation.

review_improvement: Prevents both an OS reservation from causing false failure and a Type 17 header count from masquerading as capacity evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: The source validates a displayed firmware quantity. Automated inventory can calculate comparison values but cannot prove the rendered field/unit, so the case is MANUAL ONLY.
no_automatic_retry: Do not re-enter Setup automatically after a mismatch; preserve UI and full inventory evidence for engineering reconciliation.
